# cubepath_kubernetes_node_pool (Resource)

Manages a Kubernetes node pool on CubePath Cloud.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) UUID of the Kubernetes cluster.
- `name` (String) Name of the node pool.
- `plan` (String) Server plan for the nodes.

### Optional

- `auto_scale` (Boolean) Enable auto scaling.
- `labels` (Map of String) Kubernetes labels applied to nodes in this pool.
- `node_count` (Number) Desired number of worker nodes.
- `taints` (Attributes List) Kubernetes taints applied to nodes in this pool. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--taints))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The UUID of the node pool.
- `max_nodes` (Number) Maximum number of nodes (set by the API).
- `min_nodes` (Number) Minimum number of nodes (set by the API).
- `nodes` (Attributes List) Current nodes in the pool. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nodes))

<a id="nestedatt--taints"></a>
### Nested Schema for `taints`

Required:

- `effect` (String) Taint effect (NoSchedule, NoExecute, PreferNoSchedule).
- `key` (String) Taint key.
- `value` (String) Taint value.


<a id="nestedatt--nodes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `nodes`

Read-Only:

- `floating_ip` (String) Floating IP address.
- `k8s_status` (String) Kubernetes status of the node.
- `private_ip` (String) Private IP address.
- `vps_name` (String) VPS name of the node.
- `vps_status` (String) VPS status of the node.
